expo.name: IMP
expo.//version: MAJOR.FEATURE.FIX — bump the last number for small fixes; bump the middle one (and reset the last to 0) when something is added or reworked, like this release's words and hints; the first only for a rewrite of the whole game.

android.//intentFilters: A room QR is a plain https link so any phone camera can read it. This claims those links for the app: scan one with the installed app and Android offers to open it here instead of the browser (and remembers the choice). Without the app, the same link is just the web version. autoVerify is off on purpose — silent auto-open would need /.well-known/assetlinks.json at kostaking11.github.io/, and Pages only serves this repo under /imp.

experiments.//: GitHub Pages serves the site under /<repo-name>. Change this to match the repo, or set it to "" if the site lives at the domain root (e.g. a <username>.github.io repo).

plugins.cameraPermission: The app uses the camera only to scan a room QR code.
